Chapter 247: No Classes in the Morning; Mission Completed Again!

Translator: EndlessFantasy Translation | Editor: EndlessFantasy Translation It was a weekday morning in Jiangbei, and the road was very congested.

However, Lin Fan managed to reach Jiangbei University in just half an hour. Wherever he passed, the surrounding cars tried their best to keep a distance from him, afraid that they would accidentally bump into him.

After Lin Fan parked the Rolls-Royce Phantom, he muttered to himself, “It feels more comfortable to sit in the back row… It’s indeed more suitable to have a driver drive this car.”

Then, Lin Fan strolled toward the classroom.

However, he found that the classroom was empty.

Lin Fan took out his phone and sent a message to the dorm group.

Lin Fan typed: [Why is there no one in the classroom?]

Song Yi: [Brother Fan, you’re here? There are no classes this morning.]

Lin Fan was speechless.

Seeing this, Lin Fan’s face was filled with helplessness.

It was rare for him to come to school after the spring festival, but there were no classes?

Lin Fan could only turn around and leave the classroom. When he looked up, he happened to see the library not far away. After hesitating for a moment, he strode over.

He remembered that he still had a mission to complete.

Anyway… There was nothing much to do now, so he would complete it.

The library of Jiangbei University was always packed with people.

Looking around, other than the rows of bookshelves, there were also the surging figures of the students.

Lin Fan walked past the engineering bookshelf, the chemistry bookshelf, and the electricity bookshelf… He went straight to the mathematics bookshelf.

Modern Algebra Foundation, Abstract Algebra, Advanced Algebra, Algebra Equations, Algebra and Geometry…

About five minutes later, Lin Fan found all the books he needed to read for the mission.

Then, he hugged five thick books and looked at the seat in the distance, but all he could see was a black mass of heads.

Almost all the seats were taken.

There were a few empty seats, but they were also filled with books and information like a bright flag declaring the territory.

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, ‘Seems like… I can only stand and read.’ At this moment, an extremely magnetic voice suddenly sounded from the side. “Uhh… Do you need a seat?”

When Lin Fan heard that, he turned around slowly.

A 167cm tall girl with long black hair and a pair of black-rimmed glasses was standing behind Lin Fan with a book on number theory.

For some reason, Lin Fan felt that she looked familiar. He could not help but use his Eyes of Truth to observe her.

[Appearance: 94]

[Favorability: 65]

When Lin Fan first laid eyes on her, he guessed that her looks were above 90 points.

Therefore, he was not surprised that she scored 94 points.

His favorability had reached 65, which was far above the passing line.

Obviously, this woman had a good impression of him.

Could it be… Did he really know her?

Lin Fan nodded his head slightly with a hint of doubt in his heart, “I need a seat.”

“I… There’s an available seat beside me,” the girl said.

After saying that, she took the lead and walked forward.

After a while, the two of them came to an empty space with two stacks of documents.

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony and sat down. He opened Modern Algebra Foundation and started flipping through it.

[Skill: Scanning]

One page, two pages, three pages, four pages…

Immediately, the sound of books being flipped could be heard.

In about two minutes, he was done reading the hundred-page Modern Algebra Foundation.

Then, there was Abstract Algebra, Advanced Algebra, Algebra Equations, as well as Algebra and Geometry.

He finished reading all five thick and obscure books in less than ten minutes. At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed the mission-Read Modern Algebra Foundation, Abstract Algebra, Advanced Algebra, Algebra Equations, Algebra and Geometry. You’ve obtained the proof process of the Hail Conjecture.]

All of a sudden, many complicated calculations and formulas flooded through Lin Fan’s mind like a tidal wave.

After a long while, his face revealed a hint of enlightenment.

He muttered in his heart, ‘So this is how the Hail Conjecture is proven.’ When Lin Fan turned his head, he realized that the girl with black-rimmed glasses was thinking about a math question with her head lowered.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan finally remembered why he felt that she was familiar and why she had a good impression of him.

That was because…

Back then, Lin Fan had gone to the library to read ten books on earthquakes and physics in order to obtain the earthquake prediction device and its manufacturing principles.

At that time, this woman… He happened to be sitting beside her.

Before he left, Lin Fan was in a good mood.

Therefore, he even helped her answer a question.

Thinking back to what had happened, Lin Fan rubbed his nose and muttered in his heart, ‘I helped her solve the problem, and she gave me a seat. Is this karma for good people?’ Then, Lin Fan’s gaze landed on the question again.

Almost instantly, he knew how to answer the question.

However, Lin Fan did not write down the answer directly. Instead, he reminded her, “If you want to answer this question, you can first think about the basic structure of number theory.”

After all, it was better to teach people to fish than to give them fish.

The woman slowly raised her head and asked in confusion, “Basic structure?”

Lin Fan picked up a pen and paper and quickly wrote down a formula.

When the girl saw this, her beautiful eyes immediately lit up. She said in realization, “Thank you, I understand now.”

Lin Fan smiled and nodded. You should know my name, right?”

It was no wonder he thought so.

That was because Lin Fan had met her twice. Each time… she was solving math questions.

Lin Fan solved Zhou’s Conjecture and the Twin Prime Number Conjecture. He solved two mathematical problems.

He believed that if one was a mathematics major, one would be able to recognize him.

This was not Lin Fan boasting; it was the truth.

However…

The woman shook her head and said, “I don’t…”

This sentence almost made Lin Fan choke.

“I’m a physics major,” the woman said. “My name is Lu Ling.”

Only then did Lin Fan recover. Physics major…No wonder.

He cleared his throat and said, “My name is Lin Fan.”

After saying each other’s names, the two of them seemed to be more familiar with each other.

“I see that you often flip through a lot of books. Are you looking for something?” Lu Lin asked.

“I guess so,” Lin Fan said.

What could he say?

That he was just reading normally?

Lu Lin would probably ask again, “Then how do you read so fast?”

Would Lin Fan then say that not only did he finish reading everything but he could even memorize everything without missing a single word?

It would be a little troublesome to explain.

Lin Fan hated trouble, so he did not bother explaining..
